title: Riyadh Season 2026-2027 (Big Time)
description: Riyadh Season's seventh edition, themed 'Big Time', opened October 21, 2026 with a 10-week headline programme of sport, concerts, cultural experiences and family entertainment across Riyadh (Boulevard City, Boulevard World, Winter Al Dirah, VIA Riyadh and other zones). Visit Saudi lists the wider season through March 1, 2027; some zones stay open longer than the main programme.
source: General Entertainment Authority (GEA) -- Riyadh Season; saudilifeguide.com

title: Boulevard World (Riyadh Season 2026-2027)
description: Boulevard World, Riyadh Season's international-pavilion entertainment zone, opened October 30, 2026 for the 2026-2027 season and is confirmed open until May 22, 2027. Weekday hours 4pm-midnight (SAR 30+), weekend hours 4pm-1am (SAR 40+); children under five enter free. This edition adds four new country pavilions: Yemen, Portugal, Uzbekistan and the Netherlands, plus attractions including Amazonia Awakens, a cable car, a dolphinarium and BLVD Forest.
source: listmag.com -- 'All the unmissable events confirmed for Riyadh Season 2026'; saudilifeguide.com zones table

title: AlDirah Winter / Winter Al Dirah (شتاء الديرة)
description: Riyadh Season's heritage zone in old Riyadh (Al Moaiqliah Plaza, Al Qaisariah market, near Qasr Al Hokm), with Najdi heritage experiences, Samri nights, food and art, running for roughly 128 days from November 1, 2026. NOTE: this conflicts with an earlier-seen opening estimate of October 21 for the same zone -- saudilifeguide.com's November 1 date (with a stated 128-day run) is the more specific of the two sources and is used here, but verify the exact opening date against riyadhseason.com before import.
source: saudilifeguide.com -- Riyadh Season 2026 zones table

title: GC Playoffs (Show Jumping, Riyadh Season)
description: The Global Champions Tour GC Playoffs, an elite show-jumping championship, returns to Riyadh November 18-21, 2026, as part of Riyadh Season's sporting calendar, hosted in the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD).
source: gcglobalchampions.com -- 'GC Playoffs Return to Riyadh: Dates Announced for 2026'

title: Fadel Chaker Live in Riyadh ("The Return Night")
description: Fadel Chaker's first concert in 14 years, 'The Return Night', at the Abu Bakr Salem Stage in Boulevard City, 7pm. A second night (Oct 23) was added due to high demand. Entry 15+.
source: listmag.com -- 'All the unmissable events confirmed for Riyadh Season 2026'; thenationalnews.com
location: Abu Bakr Salem Stage, Boulevard City, Riyadh

title: WWE Crown Jewel (Riyadh Season)
description: WWE Crown Jewel returns to Riyadh Season on Saturday, November 7, 2026 at 7:00 PM, at Riyadh Season Stadium in the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD) -- part of the build-up to Riyadh hosting WrestleMania 43 in 2027. Champion-vs-champion matches in both the men's and women's divisions. International broadcast via Netflix. NOTE: one source (saudilifeguide.com's early table) lists SAR 80 as the starting price, while listmag.com (later-dated) says a price was not yet available at time of writing -- verify the final price on webook.com before import.
source: goal.com; factmagazines.com; sabq.org; saudilifeguide.com; listmag.com
price: From SAR 80 (reported; unconfirmed as of this writing)
location: Riyadh Season Stadium, King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD), Riyadh

title: Six Kings Slam 2026 (Tennis)
description: Six Kings Slam 2026, the exhibition tennis tournament featuring Jannik Sinner, Carlos Alcaraz, Novak Djokovic, Alexander Zverev, Taylor Fritz and Alex de Minaur, was postponed from its original October 21/22/24, 2026 dates to late December 2026, at ANB Arena, Riyadh. NOTE: listmag.com gives the new dates as December 27-30, but saudilifeguide.com's table lists 'Dec 27, 28 and 30' (skipping the 29th) -- verify the exact match days before import. The tournament image used in some coverage is explicitly captioned as AI-generated, not a real photo.
source: listmag.com; saudilifeguide.com; goal.com
